postconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 2 * 10^5.
The tree has exactly n - 1 edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i, v_i <= n for u_i, v_i in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge connects vertices within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
postconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself.
The given edges form a valid tree.
There exists at least one valid pair of vertices that satisfy the conditions.

invariants.expression: all(u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
invariants.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself.
The graph formed by the edges is connected.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.
There are no cycles in the graph.
